purpose: Phase 1 scientific hardening: harder entry target + multi-window expanding-origin evaluation
holdout_origin_rule: last K origins with at least one purged training example; for these quarterly origins that is also the last K chronological origins

purge.rule: A training example may only be used at origin t when its label window has matured: cutoff + horizon_months <= t. Otherwise the label encodes events inside (t, t+horizon], i.e. the test window.

split: expanding-window rolling-origin, no random temporal split

algorithm.name: logistic_regression_batch_gd
algorithm.note: identical algorithm and hyperparameters in every window and ablation

continuation.definition: Any material public FDA 510(k)/original-or-panel-track PMA activity for an already-active company-track pair in the next 12 months

entry.definition: First material public FDA 510(k)/original-or-panel-track PMA activity in a technology track the company had not touched for >= dormancy_months before the cutoff
entry.candidate_universe: cross product of companies with >=1 material event by t and tracks observed by t
entry.left_censoring: The bulk window starts 2016-11-01; 'dormant' means no observed event inside the observed window, not provably inactive before it. Event dates are decision dates with availability estimated as decision_date+14d.

ablations.rd_only: shared R&D/regulatory history features (plus entry-specific features for the entry target)
ablations.rd_financial: the same features plus eleven consolidated SEC Company Facts features

metrics: mean lead time among positive targets
per-window mean/std across the last K origins
paired bootstrap AP(model)-AP(pair base rate) per window

excluded_from_historical_gain.procurement: USAspending current snapshot cannot reconstruct first-publication time

notes: A public regulatory milestone is a lagging R&D proxy. The continuation target is not first entry; the entry target is first *observed* entry inside the 2016-11-01..2026-10-15 bulk window and is left-censored. Neither target measures internal R&D start, product revenue or a causal market->R&D effect.
